launches.title: Avina: GTM Agents to Reach Your Next Customer
launches.tagline: Avina finds the companies that actually need your product right now, qualifies them, and automatically engages them with personalized AI outreach
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Create your dream GTM motion at the speed of thought. Describe your ideal buyer or buying trigger in a single sentence. Avina finds matching companies 24/7, enriches them with verified contacts, writes personalized sequences tied to the exact signal, and syncs leads wherever your team works. Signal to AI outbound, fully automated. Starting at $149/mo.

👋 Hey friends, we're Vivek and Mike (YC S22). We previously built and sold Bowtie to Mindbody, and now we're building Avina to fix outbound.

<https://youtu.be/rdUnYD9Z6Ac>

**The problem**

Generic outbound is dying, but doing smart outbound is still painfully hard.

The pitches that get replies are the ones that arrive right when something happening at the prospect's company makes your product feel relevant. The hard part has always been finding those moments at scale and acting on them fast.

**Our solution**

Avina finds the companies that actually need your product right now, qualifies them, and automatically engages them with personalized AI outreach. All synced with your existing sales stack.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99611&key=user_uploads/185378/d34b49d3-f41b-4940-83da-11472e593ba8)

**How it works**

Describe your ideal buyer or buying trigger in a single sentence:

* _Selling usage-based billing?_ "PLG companies that just launched an API in the last 3 months"
* _Selling compliance automation?_ "Companies awarded a prime DoD contract in the last 30 days"
* _Selling cybersecurity?_ "Healthcare companies that experienced a data breach in the last 6 months"
* _Selling voice AI?_ "Mid-market home services companies with recent negative reviews mentioning 'long wait times' or 'understaffed'"

It works for first-party intent too. Website visitor de-anonymization is built in (RB2B, Vector, and more), so you can act on inbound signals like "prospects that visited our pricing page for more than 2 min.”

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99611&key=user_uploads/185378/601dc08e-720f-4466-9deb-433c0902d7df)

Avina takes it from there. Four agents handle the full pipeline:

1. **Signals Agent** monitors the web 24/7 for matching companies: press releases, job posts, LinkedIn posts, technographics, inbound site visitors, and more
2. **Qualification Agent** scores leads against your ICP, finds your target contact at the company, and enriches them with verified contact details.
3. **Outbound Agent** researches each company, writes personalized emails tied to the specific trigger, and sends via your existing sequencer (Instantly, HubSpot, Lemlist, Smartlead) so you keep your warmed domains
4. **Workflow Agent** syncs every lead to the rest of your stack: CRM lists, Slack, Clay, Zapier, and more

**Try it free!**

Start a 14-day free trial at [avina.io](http://avina.io).

Not sure what signals to start with? Our in-product **Signal Recommender** analyzes your website and suggests high-impact buying triggers, and we have a[ library of 250+ examples for inspiration](https://avina.io/signals-library).

launches.title: Avina - X-ray vision for your sales team 🩻✨
launches.tagline: See what your leads are reading on your site, and use AI to move those deals forward - fast.
launches.body:
# **⚡️ TL;DR**

Avina is an AI sales companion for full-cycle sellers.

* Use Avina’s advanced reasoning to get custom buying signals on your accounts. Don’t waste $$ on stale databases that aren’t tailored to your business!
* Get x-ray alerts on **exactly what your prospects are reading** on your site to turn marketing engagement into booked meetings.
* Use every insight to draft perfect messages using Avina’s in-context email and LinkedIn drafting.
* Get pre and post-meeting briefs tailored to your business and playbooks so you never miss a deal-moving detail.
* Avina fills out all your CRM fields after every call, saving you 5-10 hours a week.

Using Avina, sellers get help at every step of the journey to move deals forward - fast. 

### **The Problem:**

The predictable revenue model is dead, and AI SDRs are flooding channels with noise. Sellers need a better way to break through without wasting hours trying to comb through various systems to find the right insights to move a deal forward.

### **The Solution:**

<https://youtu.be/vq2wIYpSznE>

**AI isn’t here to replace you. It’s here to guide you to take the optimal action and free you of tedious, repetitive labor.**

Step 1. Use Avina’s AI crawler to get the exact signals you need to prioritize accounts.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86233&key=user_uploads/989537/6c3dd813-590a-4f4a-9597-4939b6a6a4cf)

Step 2. Draft the perfect email or LinkedIn message using Avina’s Chrome extension to get your target leads to notice you and drive them to your site!

Step 3. Get real-time x-ray alerts on _exactly what they are reading or screenshotting on your site._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86233&key=user_uploads/989537/654fbc30-d36f-4a97-b0ab-9aec38987e9a)

Step 4. Use Avina’s Slack bot to research and craft messaging for accounts on the topics that matter most to them.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86233&key=user_uploads/989537/e7ef2eca-1eae-4af7-b480-d7f69c9c49be)

Step 5. Get the meeting!

Step 6. Get a pre-call brief from Avina with the full context about the account.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86233&key=user_uploads/989537/e6daea04-a598-4c32-82b9-a4acc3c9477b)

Step 7. Record, transcribe, and extract key information from the call using Avina’s call bot.

Step 8. Get a post-call brief mapped to your playbook, tracking everything that moves your deals forward.

Step 9. Push info that Avina captured on the call to your CRM right from Slack!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86233&key=user_uploads/989537/dcedfb04-ce60-4f96-8896-a30f5d100ee3)

\
**Avina is plug-and-play. Go live in as little as 30 minutes.**

📈 Businesses see a 30% increase in opportunities created.

⏳ Sellers save 5-10 hours of manual work a week.

💡 Execs get the data they need to make the best decisions.

**The Team** 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86233&key=user_uploads/989537/aac13df0-3550-4f0b-8d90-eb6bcc481b03)

We’re Mike, Vivek, and Ron, 2x co-founders who have seen how useful data there is for sellers, if only they had a little help making use of it. 

Want X-ray vision or your team? [Book time with us here](https://calendly.com/meshwithron/avina-x-ray-vision-for-your-sellers)

Or reach out directly: [ron@avina.io](mailto:ron@avina.io)
